jobs.jobDescription:
Who are we?

At UpGuard, we are replacing manual security bottlenecks with AI-driven precision. Fresh off a US$75M Series C, we are scaling our infrastructure to process 100 billion risk signals daily. This isn’t just growth; it’s a total reimagining of how the world manages cyber risk.

We build the Cyber Risk Posture Management (CRPM) platform that security teams actually love. By integrating security ratings, threat intel, and agentic AI, we empower organisations to stay ahead of an ever evolving attack surface.

We aren’t just building another tool; we’re defining a category. We provide the autonomy to ship world-class technology and the resources to do it at a global scale.

Where does this role fit in?

We are looking for a dynamic, self-motivated, and ambitious strategic thinker with a successful track record to join our leadership team as a Manager of Account Management. This position will report to the Head of Customer Success, Americas. Our Account Management team is focused on driving revenue retention and expansion through renewals, cross-sells, and upsells for our highest-touch customers. We work closely with Sales, Marketing, and Product to ensure customer satisfaction and long-term success.

What will you do?

  • Build and lead a team of Account Managers focused on managing renewals, cross-sells, and upsells for high-touch customers

  • Scale, mentor, and develop a high-performing Account Management team

  • Accurately forecast monthly and quarterly revenue retention and expansion results

  • Drive strategy and build executive relationships for top accounts

  • Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams (Sales, Marketing, Product) to optimize results and customer engagement

  • Use data and metrics to assess team performance and implement improvement initiatives

  • Ensure adherence to UpGuard’s post-sale processes and standards

  • Foster a culture of accountability and customer-first thinking within the team

  • Build close alignment with team leaders and individual contributors to support mentorship and career growth for high-performers

  • Develop and execute customer retention strategies, ensuring high customer satisfaction and long-term account stability.

What will you bring?

  • A minimum of 2 years of leadership experience managing Account Managers or similar post-sales teams, with a proven track record in revenue retention and expansion

  • At least 3 years of experience in B2B SaaS as an individual contributor, ideally with a focus on renewals, cross-sells, upsells, and a proven track record

  • Experience in leveraging post-sales technology stacks such as Hubspot (CRM) and Gong (Revenue Intelligence) to coach and guide your team

  • Demonstrated ability to plan, monitor, and optimize post-sale activities based on team performance and customer feedback

  • A problem-solver who simplifies complex challenges and fosters collaboration across teams

  • Leadership with an executive presence, capable of influencing at all levels

  • A customer-centric mindset, passionate about building and nurturing long-term relationships

  • A goal-oriented, collaborative approach that thrives on teamwork and diverse perspectives

What will give you an edge?

  • Familiarity with MEDDPICC sales methodology and process

  • Experience with cybersecurity and TPRM (Third-Party Risk Management) products

What's in it for you?

  • Monthly Lifestyle subsidy:Use this for financial, physical, and mental well-being

  • WFH set-up allowance:To ensure you have the right environment to work in, we will help you get set up within your first 3 months at UpGuard

  • $1500 USD annual Learning & Development allowance: To support your career development, all team members will be able to expense development opportunities against this allowance

  • Annual leave:PTO plus two additional UpGuardian leave days to give you time to recharge your batteries.

  • 18 weeks paid Parental Leave: Irrespective of parenting role

  • Personal Leave Allowance: This includes sick & carer’s leave

  • Fully remote working environment: While we have physical offices in Sydney & Hobart, we do not mandate compulsory attendance

  • Top-spec hardware: All team members will be provided with top-spec laptops for their role

  • Generative AI subsidy: UpGuard provides paid subscriptions for all team members to access generative AI tools to support their work.

  • Health Insurance: Access to comprehensive coverage.

UpGuard is a Certified Great Place to Work® in the US, Australia, UK and India, establishing its position as a leading global technology employer. 99% of team members agree that UpGuard is a great place to work! Apply now to find out why!

As an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employer, qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, or disability status.

Please Note: Not all roles can be performed from the United States. Please check your specific job listing to confirm its advertised location. If the role you are applying for is listed as based in the US, we are currently only able to support hiring in the following locations: CA, CO, FL, IL, MA, MD, MO, OR, PA, TX, WA, and DC.

Before starting work with us, you will need to undertake a national police history check and reference checks.

jobs.jobDescription:
RevenueCat gives app businesses the infrastructure and tools to build, run, and improve their monetization. Since graduating from YC's S18 batch, we've grown into the default monetization platform for mobile.

We're in 50%+ of newly shipped subscription apps, we process $16B+ in annual purchase volume, and we help everyone from a solo developer to the OpenAI mobile team understand and grow their revenue.

We're a remote-first team of 150+ people across 25+ countries, guided by values we actually practice: Customer Obsession, Always Be Shipping, Own It, and Balance.

This isn't the right fit for everyone. The systems you’ll build here manage billions of dollars and touch hundreds of millions of end users, and we don’t take that lightly. You'll be expected to work hard and hold a high bar for what you ship, alongside some of the sharpest, most driven people you've worked with. If that sounds energizing rather than exhausting, keep reading.

The Role

RC Capital is RevenueCat's first move into financial services. Our first product, Early Payouts, gives developers access to App Store proceeds without waiting the usual 30 to 60 days for Apple and Google to pay them.

As Sales & Operations Specialist, RC Capital, you will own the customer lifecycle end-to-end - from identifying and qualifying suitable prospects through screening, onboarding, activation, ongoing support, account operations, and portfolio health. You will combine commercial judgment, customer care, operational discipline, and risk awareness to help RC Capital acquire and serve more healthy customers.

This is a hands-on individual-contributor role on a small founding team. You might move from a discovery call to an onboarding issue, a portfolio review, and a workflow improvement in the same day. You will work closely with Sales, Support, Product, Data, Finance, Legal, Marketing, and GTM Operations, and report to the VP of Strategy & Operations. You will also help build the playbook and systems future teammates inherit.

What You'll Own:

  • Sales and qualification. Manage a portfolio of inbound and targeted outbound opportunities. Run discovery, assess product and customer fit, coordinate screening, handle objections, maintain momentum, and guide suitable prospects to a clear decision.

  • Onboarding and activation. Lead approved customers from decision to activated. Ensure customers understand how to use Early Payouts successfully.

  • Customer support and portfolio operations. Serve as a reliable point of contact for customers, including questions, disputes, and operational issues. Coordinate with RevenueCat Support and specialist teams, and own follow-through through resolution.

  • Risk-aware execution. Apply documented customer, fraud, and risk policies consistently; investigate issues; document decisions; monitor emerging patterns; and make sound recommendations. Escalate exceptions and regulated or high-impact decisions to the appropriate risk, legal, finance, or leadership owner.

  • Lifecycle performance and insight. Maintain a reliable view of pipeline, onboarding, support demand, usage, and portfolio health. Turn data into recommendations on funnel quality, conversion, time to activation, drop-off, retention, customer experience, and risk indicators. Bring structured customer insight to Product to inform roadmaps.

  • Systems, automation, and playbooks. Improve CRM, support workflows, internal handoffs, reporting, documentation, and automation. Use AI thoughtfully to reduce manual work and response times without weakening controls or customer trust. Partner with Marketing, Operations, Data, and Product on durable implementations.

  • Customer and growth. Partner with Marketing on focused acquisition and lifecycle experiments. Support marketing efforts like campaign execution, competitive analysis, and content that drives demand.

What We're Looking For

  • 4+ years in a high-ownership, customer-facing commercial or operations role spanning sales, account management, customer success, customer support, or customer operations.

  • A track record of moving opportunities through a commercial process and managing a meaningful volume of customer relationships with strong follow-through.

  • Experience in fintech, payments, lending, factoring, embedded finance, or another environment where customer growth and operational risk are closely connected.

  • 1-2 years of marketing or growth experience running campaigns or managing CRM-driven outreach.

  • Strong operational judgment: you clarify ownership, define next steps, document decisions, apply policy consistently, and recognize when an issue needs specialist review.

  • Analytical fluency across CRM, support, and analytics tools, with the ability to diagnose funnel or portfolio performance and recommend action.

  • Practical experience improving workflows with automation and AI, including judgment about where automation introduces unacceptable risk or a poor customer experience.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication: persuasive with prospects, clear during onboarding, calm in disputes, and concise with executives and cross-functional partners.

  • Comfort operating in ambiguity on a small, autonomous team and working hours that meaningfully overlap with US time zones.

Nice to Have

  • Direct experience with payment operations, underwriting, fraud and risk workflows, disputes, or compliance-adjacent processes.

  • Experience launching a new product, business line, or operating motion before the playbook was written.

  • Knowledge of mobile apps, developer products, subscriptions, or App Store economics.

  • Experience contributing to CRM or lifecycle campaigns, customer-facing content, or growth experiments.

  • Familiarity with tools such as Salesforce, Notion, Linear, Intercom or Zendesk, Slack, Zoom, and product analytics platforms.

What success looks like

In your first 30 days

  • Understand RC Capital's product, customers, unit economics, risk model, and role within RevenueCat.

  • Map the lifecycle from first signal through activation and live-account support.

  • Establish baseline reporting for pipeline quality, conversion, time to decision, time to activation, support demand, repeat usage, and portfolio health.

  • Shadow sales, onboarding, support, risk, and account reviews; then handle initial customer interactions with support.

  • Ship one concrete improvement to a workflow, report, playbook, or automation.

By 90 days

  • Independently own a portfolio from qualification and screening through onboarding and ongoing operations, escalating genuine exceptions appropriately.

  • Give the team a reliable view of pipeline, onboarding, support, usage, and portfolio performance, with recommendations rather than reporting alone.

  • Run a consistent cadence for opportunity follow-up, onboarding, live-account reviews, and issue resolution.

  • Ship workflow or automation improvements that reduce manual work or customer wait time without weakening controls.

  • Support marketing efforts to deliver on targets.

  • Translate recurring customer and operational friction into structured recommendations for Product, Data, Finance, Legal, Support, or Marketing.

By 6 to 12 months

  • Improve key lifecycle measures such as conversion, activation speed, utilization and retention.

  • Help grow a portfolio of healthy customers while keeping fraud, disputes, losses, and other agreed risk indicators within guardrails.

  • Maintain a commercial and customer-operations playbook another teammate can follow without relying on context held only in people's heads.

  • Help turn the early motion into a repeatable engine and identify which responsibilities should move to partner teams or future hires as volume grows.

What we offer:

  • Competitive equity in a fast-growing, Series C startup backed by top-tier investors, including Y Combinator

  • 10-year window to exercise vested equity options

  • A fully remote environment designed around autonomy and flexibility

  • 4-5 weeks of flexible time off annually

  • Paid desk at a co-working space

  • Workspace budget and continuous learning stipend

Interviewing at RevenueCat

Our interview process is rigorous on purpose. We want to be sure that everyone we bring on is genuinely excited about this work, aligned with how we operate, and ready to meet our high bar for performance. Curious what that actually looks like? Read more in our blog post on how we hire at RevenueCat, including tips to help you succeed.

More on how we work:

  • How we think about hiring and team design: Building a Winning Team

  • The values that guide how we work: Our Values

  • How we work as a remote team: How We Work Remotely at RevenueCat

  • What to expect from our interview process: Interview Expectations

  • What to expect from comp and employment: Employment FAQ

jobs.jobDescription:
Level: ES2-ES5

Hiring Manager:

Recruiter: Celine Clark

At Qualtrics, we create software the world’s best brands use to deliver exceptional frontline experiences, build high-performing teams, and design products people love. But we are more than a platform—we are the creators and stewards of the Experience Management category serving over 18K clients globally. Building a category takes grit, determination, and a disdain for convention—but most of all it requires close-knit, high-functioning teams with an unwavering dedication to serving our customers.

When you join one of our teams, you’ll be part of a nimble group that’s empowered to set aggressive goals and move fast to achieve them. Strategic risks are encouraged and complex problems are solved together, by passing the mic and iterating until the best solution comes to light. You won’t have to look to find growth opportunities—ready or not, they’ll find you. From retail to government to healthcare, we’re on a mission to bring humanity, connection, and empathy back to business. Join over 5,000 people across the globe who think that’s work worth doing.

Enterprise Account Executive – Financial Services

Why We Have This Role

Our Enterprise Account Executive team is a group of highly driven individuals dedicated to closing experience gaps across the world’s leading financial institutions. In the modern Financial Services sector—spanning retail banking, wealth management, commercial banking, insurance, and fintech—digital transformation, client retention, regulatory compliance, omnichannel service, and advisor/employee experience are top priorities. Our SaaS platform empowers global financial institutions to capture real-time customer feedback, elevate digital and branch interactions, and drive action with pre-built Experience Management (XM) programs.

How You’ll Find Success

  • Takes Initiative: Understands the expected outcome, grasps complex financial service ecosystems, and works entrepreneurially to execute.

  • Domain & Industry Acumen: Deep understanding of key business drivers, metrics, and buyer personas in Financial Services (e.g., Net Promoter Score/CSAT, customer churn prevention, digital adoption, wealth advisor retention, branch experience, and client lifetime value).

  • Proven Deal Closer: Strong track record of consistently exceeding quota and acquiring high-value enterprise financial accounts.

  • Complex Solution Selling: Ability to sell a multi-solution, enterprise-grade SaaS platform (Qualtrics Experience Management) into large, matrixed financial institutions with complex governance and security requirements.

  • Strategic Negotiation: Skilled in navigating strict procurement procedures, vendor risk management (VRM) assessments, regulatory compliance evaluations, and enterprise contract negotiations.

How You'll Grow

  • Structured, 100% performance-based promotion pathway.

  • Dedicated Career Action Planning alongside your leadership team.

  • Internal mobility opportunities (Qmobility) across global teams and territories.

Things You’ll Do

  • Quarterback strategic enterprise deals with Fortune 500 banks, wealth management firms, insurance carriers, and fintech leaders in your territory.

  • Consistently hit and exceed quarterly and annual revenue quotas.

  • Cultivate C-level and VP-level relationships across Consumer Banking, Wealth & Asset Management, Digital Transformation, Customer Experience (CX), Operations, and Human Resources.

  • Develop and maintain deep domain knowledge of Qualtrics’ XM offerings and how they solve financial services challenges (e.g., digital banking feedback loops, branch customer satisfaction, advisor onboarding/retention, insurance claims experience, and Voice of the Customer).

  • Maintain a real-time understanding of the competitive landscape to build win-based proposals and strategic pricing models.

  • Partner cross-functionally with internal teams (Professional Services, Solutions Engineering, SME Leads, and Customer Success) to orchestrate collaborative, high-impact enterprise sales cycles.

What We’re Looking For On Your Resume

  • A validated top performer with a proven track record of breakthrough sales results.

  • 5–10+ years of direct enterprise SaaS sales experience, preferably targeting Banking, Financial Services, Insurance (BFSI), or Fintech sectors.

  • Bachelor’s degree or higher required.

  • Demonstrated mastery of the MEDDPICC / MEDDIC sales process.

  • Strong proficiency in Salesforce.com and sales forecasting hygiene.

  • Experience developing complex business cases and ROI models focused on account retention, digital adoption, risk mitigation, and client lifetime value.

  • Proven track record of navigating long, complex contract negotiations with highly regulated financial enterprises.

  • Ability to travel up to 50% as needed for key client meetings, executive briefings, and industry summits.

What You Should Know About This Team

  • Dedicated to Financial Sector Demand: Meeting surging demand from enterprise financial leaders who are modernizing their institutions to transform client, policyholder, and employee engagement.

  • Strategic & Collaborative Team: Goal-oriented, high-energy group that collaborates closely to navigate complex security and procurement cycles to win market leadership.

  • Focused on Growth & Trust: Driven by an overarching objective to generate exponential revenue growth by empowering financial leaders to deliver exceptional, trust-building experiences across every channel.

Our Team’s Favorite Perks and Benefits

  • Competitive Compensation: Competitive Base Salary + Uncapped Commissions and Performance Accelerators.

  • Merit-Based Growth: 100% performance-based promotions—driven by results, not politics or tenure.

  • Culture: A vibrant, inclusive work environment—wear jeans and bring your dog to the office anytime.

  • Team & Swag: Quarterly team outings, winter and summer parties, and exclusive team swag.

  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive private health insurance, wellness stipend, and rich mental/physical health benefits.

  • Qualtrics Experience Bonus: An annual cash bonus designed specifically for you to fund a personal dream experience—whether that’s a dream vacation, attending a major event, or personal passion projects.

The Qualtrics Hybrid Work Model: While this role is exempt from working in office, our hybrid work model remains elegantly simple for the rest of the company: we all gather in the office three days a week; Mondays and Thursdays, plus one day selected by your organizational leader. These purposeful in-person days in thoughtfully designed offices help us do our best work and harness the power of collaboration and innovation. For the rest of the week, work where you want, owning the integration of work and life. #remote

Qualtrics is an equal opportunity employer meaning that all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other protected characteristic.

​​​​​​​Applicants in the United States of America have rights under Federal Employment Laws:Family & Medical Leave Act,Equal Opportunity Employment,Employee Polygraph Protection Act

Qualtrics is committed to the inclusion of all qualified individuals. As part of this commitment, Qualtrics will ensure that persons with disabilities are provided with reasonable accommodations. If reasonable accommodation is needed to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and/or to receive other benefits and privileges of employment, please let your Qualtrics contact/recruiter know.
